audience: An owner running a personal team of bots
universe: Control Room: conversations, approvals and bot computers
signature: Violet-grey bot channels and computers frame the conversation; amber marks requests waiting for the owner.
rationale: The conversation remains central, with bot channels and optional computers. Workflow editing extends the approved surfaces, type, focus and bot palette without changing the chat layout. Imports, queued messages, optional cloud computers and update notices use the existing controls and translation catalog.
